title: Automotive GNSS positioning element: ISO 26262 safety element out of context and ISO 21448 (SOTIF) evidence
status: No accepted method shows that a GNSS protection level bounds the error under SOTIF triggering conditions (research 07 G11)

source.read: Not read in this work; rows at topic level.
